title: Emergency water storage
aliases: how much water should i store
tldr: Store at least one gallon of water per person per day for three days; aim for two weeks if practical. Allow more for heat, illness, pregnancy and pets. Use commercially bottled water or clean food-grade containers, and keep it cool and away from chemicals.
steps: Count people and days and add water for pets and extra needs.
Use commercially bottled water or food-grade containers intended for water.
Mark fill dates and store away from sunlight, fuel and cleaning products.
Follow bottled-water dates and replace self-filled stored water every six months.
next: Learn the local advisory system. Plan how to transport water if distribution sites open.
watch: Do not reuse containers that held toxic substances, even after washing.
shopping: Commercially bottled water or food-grade storage containers
Additional water for pets and medical needs
